english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for intentionally causing someone severe physical or emotional suffering.
Use this everyday default when someone or something causes another person severe mental or physical suffering.
This is the all-purpose verb for causing someone or an animal severe physical or emotional suffering.

examples.english: Those kidnappers torture the hostage to force him to say where the ransom is hidden.
examples.traditional: 嗰班綁匪折磨人質，逼佢交代贖款藏喺邊。
